note: DT.1d: a TypeScript HTTP call site's wire shapes ride on its ENDPOINT_HIT (code-domain wire::append_hit_fields): `response` from the call's type argument (Angular HttpClient / axios), `request` from the body argument whose position the library fixes (HttpClient / axios post, put, patch: the second argument; its declared parameter type or an object literal's keys), fetch's `JSON.stringify(<expr>)` body and `(await res.json()) as T`. Type names stay unresolved text (the models pass resolves them). `T | null` reads as T; an inline envelope type is an object shape. `await axios.get<T>(..)` parses as call(await(instantiation(member, type_arguments)), arguments) in tree-sitter-typescript 0.23.2, and before DT.1d minted no ENDPOINT at all.
